confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on 2026 UK aggregates: the Morning Advertiser April 2026 average pint (GBP 5.34), Pocketwise 2026 Bristol price guide, Finder UK coffee average, and Expatistan cocktail estimates (few data points). Wine is inferred from beer and venue examples because no restaurant-specific wine average was found. GBP to USD uses an assumed 1.30 USD per GBP that was not sourced from any search. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no live listings inspected, so they are low confidence. The FX figure is unverified: it came from a search summary that cited the RBA exchange rates page for 20 March 2026, but I did not read the RBA page, and that observation may not be the latest available on 2026-10-16. Verify against rba.gov.au (table F11) before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use UK national and regional averages, adjusted to a Bristol city-centre level and roughly in line with other large English regional cities, excluding London. Accommodation anchors are based on general knowledge of mid-sized English cities in peak summer, not Bristol-specific listings.
